turn.text:
Require users to log in at a web portal backed by our RADIUS server 10.1.0.60 (secret 'r4dsec') before internet access, and apply their per-user policy.

Site notes: the office LAN 192.168.10.0/24 is on fw eth1 (192.168.10.1), the internet on eth2. The RADIUS server already lists fw (10.1.0.1) as a client and returns each user's policy as Filter-Id: `staff` (full internet access) or `web` (HTTP/HTTPS only). The lab's portal daemon /lab/bin/nb-portal (`--listen IP:PORT --radius HOST --secret SECRET`) authenticates a login against RADIUS and adds the client's address to the nft set `inet filter portal_<Filter-Id>`; serve it on 192.168.10.1:8080. The device has no systemd: start daemons directly.
Plan: nft add set inet filter portal_staff '{ type ipv4_addr; }'; nft add set inet filter portal_web '{ type ipv4_addr; }'; nft insert rule inet filter forward iifname eth1 ip saddr @portal_web drop; nft insert rule inet filter forward iifname eth1 ip saddr @portal_web tcp dport { 80, 443 } accept; nft insert rule inet filter forward iifname eth1 oifname eth2 ip saddr != @portal_staff ip saddr != @portal_web drop; nohup /lab/bin/nb-portal --listen 192.168.10.1:8080 --radius 10.1.0.60 --secret r4dsec >/var/log/nb-portal.out 2>&1 &
